statement: theorem singleton_subgradient_tendsto {ι : Type*} (l : Filter ι) [NeBot l] (f : E → EReal) (hbot : ∀ y, f y ≠ ⊥) (hf : IsConvexExtended f) (x g : E) (hx : x ∈ interior (effectiveDomain f)) (hg : SourceSubdifferential f x = {g}) (xs gs : ι → E) (hxs : Tendsto xs l (𝓝 x)) (hs : ∀ᶠ i in l, gs i ∈ SourceSubdifferential f (xs i)) : Tendsto gs l (𝓝 g)
